sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: traffic signs and signals
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Pages in this range are largely sign pictures with captions; facts were taken only from the written paragraphs, never from a picture or caption, so individual sign designs are not asserted here [A03].
The manual counts seven common colors and seven common shapes; the shape list on the shapes page names the pennant and the five-sided school sign, and both are taught as printed [A02].
The stop-position paragraph also says to stop perpendicular to the stop sign when there is no stop line; that wording is unclear and was not turned into a fact [A09] (verify IN-SIGNS-D-PERP).
The two-minute red-light rule is printed for bicyclists at bicycle signals and for motorcycles and motor driven cycles, with autocycles excluded; it is not taught as a rule for cars [A09].

corpus_stability.reason: The Indiana Driver's Manual back cover reads Published July 2026 and tells readers to check IN.gov/BMV for updates; the BMV manual page says printed manuals are updated at most once a year, so the selected pages are treated as stable within a year while fees and service details stay dynamic.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page 40 says that with no stop line a driver should come to a complete stop perpendicular to the stop sign or before the crosswalk; the perpendicular wording is unclear and needs an official clarification before it is taught.
